hypothesis: Energy per accepted result is well defined only when counter brackets are valid and every counted solve meets the declared accuracy target; otherwise it must be withheld. Its denominator must say whether it counts replica solves or distinct results.
input_data: examples/energy-accuracy/{baseline,reset,missing,under-target}.json: synthetic fixtures (origin synthetic_fixture) constructed on the CPU, not hardware captures
mathematical_model: E_acc = Delta E_measurement / #{replica solves with KL(q || p) <= target}; replicas in a batch are bitwise-identical copies of one result (constant-row encoding), so E per distinct accepted result = Delta E / #{accepted batch outputs}; boundary-dependent (measurement phase only, gross, no idle subtraction).
numerical_result: baseline E_acc = 0.05 J per accepted replica solve and 0.2 J per distinct accepted result (synthetic); withheld for ['missing', 'reset', 'under-target']; naive under-target ratio 0.05 J/solve with 0 accepted; whole-run boundary ratio 7.
observation_model: Counter readings and retained batch outputs from each fixture; outputs decoded directly from the constant-row values and scored with a textbook Gaussian KL against an information-form posterior written in this module.
